title: Conditional κ = .00389821005 (+0.00000128263998% over #8057; +0.000216415179% over #8056): tighten the compact Gaussian debit
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ = 0.00389821005** in `T(n) = O(n (log n)^(1−κ))` under the five inherited all-size interfaces. The latest comparable peer #8057 reports and independently reproduces **κ = 0.00389821**. The exact absolute increase is **0.00000000005** and the exact relative gain is **(1/779642)%**, or **+0.0000012826399809143%**. Relative to #8056 at 0.0038982016137, the absolute increase is 0.0000000084363 and the relative gain is +0.0002164151789982%. The maintainer-selected #7000 result remains separate. [#8057 signed source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier) · [#8056](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8056)

The package combines the true compact 1-to-79 Gaussian schedule with 1,008 parity-aware quarter/complement paid returns on the small copy. The directed proof replaces the earlier Gaussian debit 43/256 by 339/2048, and the full price raises the second ordinary height to 561,325. It uses the same 63 cell positions with 51 changed fractions. Both ordinary height 35,327 and Gaussian height 680,000 stay fixed. All large-copy phase, cursor, owner, restoration, tape and precision costs are charged. The finite early conversion costs 573 bits. Activation is at exponent 1,277,171, total recurring coefficient has log₂ bound 340,530,371, and fixed tape setup remains at most 2^228. The comparator #8057 has smaller resource ceilings. [Independent earlier invoice and exact scoped exclusion](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/888b4e162261ffc1953ac18e867c2c21af4b8164/paired-768/r375/README.md)

The directed proof clears both installed #8057 caps, including about 0.003898210000368366 from ordinary funding. It preserves the prior paid word, signed owner interfaces, chronological compiler, precision and tape rules, and analytic integer recovery required by the inherited premises. Finite installed replay and the all-size proof are distinct. Production-scale dimensions are outside host memory. The #8057 optional portable installer was not regenerated in the comparison. Its six-mode scientific replay passed on `cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086`. Latest peer head `4c1ca64c8cad0c3a72aa49f26b084222ec400dcd` changes only the optional timing study. All four hosted checks passed on that head. [Peer hosted checks](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45070380100)

## Clean replay

Use CPython 3.12 from the exact PR checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-compact-rounded-partitions
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-compact-rounded-partitions-numerical-replay
```

The main package runs complete price, independent interval, all K7 controls, signed product/restoration and fixed setup. The companion runs the literal 6-column and 474-column numerical controls with all 564,144 charged cuts and 105,216 independent owners. The detached checks reconstruct the paid inventory and 63-cell transport, reproduce #8055 and the old compact quarter result as controls, and reject deletion of a paid quarter and reinstating the larger debit.

The release head `4ff66ca09aa7727768aeaf24ac444e69675804de` changes only the one-profile stop-rule metadata. Committed-byte, permission, ancestry, metadata and matrix preflights and the historical admission fixture passed at the release head. Onboarding passed 760 tests with 31 skips on the scientific head. The signed result is −345550037539 with complete restoration, 138 bank shuttles and 157,248 H calls. Exact local replay and the independent audit each reproduce from clean checkouts. Hosted verification is tracked separately.
